<jats:title>A<jats:sc>bstract</jats:sc>
                     </jats:title><jats:p>In a conformally flat three-dimensional spacetime, the linearised higher-spin Cotton tensor ℭ<jats:sub><jats:italic>α</jats:italic>(<jats:italic>n</jats:italic>)</jats:sub>(<jats:italic>h</jats:italic>) is the unique conserved conformal current which is a gauge-invariant descendant of the conformal gauge prepotential <jats:italic>h</jats:italic><jats:sub><jats:italic>α</jats:italic>(<jats:italic>n</jats:italic>)</jats:sub>. The explicit form of ℭ<jats:sub><jats:italic>α</jats:italic>(<jats:italic>n</jats:italic>)</jats:sub>(<jats:italic>h</jats:italic>) is well known in Minkowski space. Here we solve the problem of extending the Minkowskian result to the case of anti-de Sitter (AdS) space and derive a closed-form expression for ℭ<jats:sub><jats:italic>α</jats:italic>(<jats:italic>n</jats:italic>)</jats:sub>(<jats:italic>h</jats:italic>) in terms of the AdS Lorentz covariant derivatives. It is shown that every conformal higher-spin action <jats:inline-formula><jats:alternatives><jats:tex-math>$$ {S}_{\mathrm{CS}}^{(n)}\left[h\right]\propto \int {\mathrm{d}}^3{xeh}^{\alpha (n)}{\mathrm{\mathfrak{C}}}_{\alpha (n)}(h) $$</jats:tex-math><mml:math xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
                  <mml:msubsup>
                    <mml:mi>S</mml:mi>
                    <mml:mi>CS</mml:mi>
                    <mml:mfenced>
                      <mml:mi>n</mml:mi>
                    </mml:mfenced>
                  </mml:msubsup>
                  <mml:mfenced>
                    <mml:mi>h</mml:mi>
                  </mml:mfenced>
                  <mml:mo>∝</mml:mo>
                  <mml:mo>∫</mml:mo>
                  <mml:msup>
                    <mml:mi>d</mml:mi>
                    <mml:mn>3</mml:mn>
                  </mml:msup>
                  <mml:msup>
                    <mml:mi>xeh</mml:mi>
                    <mml:mrow>
                      <mml:mi>α</mml:mi>
                      <mml:mfenced>
                        <mml:mi>n</mml:mi>
                      </mml:mfenced>
                    </mml:mrow>
                  </mml:msup>
                  <mml:msub>
                    <mml:mi>ℭ</mml:mi>
                    <mml:mrow>
                      <mml:mi>α</mml:mi>
                      <mml:mfenced>
                        <mml:mi>n</mml:mi>
                      </mml:mfenced>
                    </mml:mrow>
                  </mml:msub>
                  <mml:mfenced>
                    <mml:mi>h</mml:mi>
                  </mml:mfenced>
                </mml:math></jats:alternatives></jats:inline-formula> factorises into a product of (<jats:italic>n −</jats:italic> 1) first-order operators that are associated with the spin-<jats:italic>n/</jats:italic>2 partially massless AdS values. Our findings greatly facilitate the on-shell analysis of massive higher-spin gauge-invariant actions in AdS<jats:sub>3</jats:sub>. The main results are extended to the case of <jats:inline-formula><jats:alternatives><jats:tex-math>$$ \mathcal{N} $$</jats:tex-math><mml:math xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
                  <mml:mi>N</mml:mi>
                </mml:math></jats:alternatives></jats:inline-formula> = 1 AdS supersymmetry. In particular, we derive simple expressions for the higher-spin super-Cotton tensors in AdS<jats:sub>3</jats:sub>.</jats:p>
title: Higher-spin Cotton tensors and massive gauge-invariant actions in AdS3
